title: Should the Left and Right Unite Against Israel? Naomi and Mehdi Debate How to Respond to Tucker, MTG, and the MAGA Antiwar Splits
author: Naomi Klein
content:
The online MAGA movement is going through another major meltdown - as far-
right influencers and pundits like [Tucker Carlson](https://www.the-
independent.com/news/world/americas/us-politics/tucker-carlson-trump-iran-
threat-b2952804.html), [Candace Owens](https://foxsanantonio.com/news/nation-
world/trump-slams-megyn-kelly-candace-owens-tucker-carlson-and-alex-jones-in-
truth-post-joe-kent-maga-iran-israel), and [Marjorie Taylor
Greene](https://www.thedailybeast.com/marjorie-taylor-greene-torches-trumps-
mental-stability-after-chilling-post/) speak out against Trump and Israel's
war on Iran, as well as the administration's cover-up of the Epstein files.

But what does this splintering mean for the left? Should people like MTG be
embraced by the left, as Rep. Ilhan Omar has
[suggested](https://www.newsweek.com/ilhan-omar-wants-to-embrace-marjorie-
taylor-greene-candace-owens-11834877), even as she continues to spread vaccine
misinformation and celebrate Jan. 6 rioters? Could this splintering actually
lead to a new, successful political coalition? Should it?

[Subscribe now](https://zeteo.com/subscribe)

In an in-person conversation in Washington DC for the latest episode of
'Unshocked,'**Naomi** and **Mehdi** cover it all and more, with the two
debating what the left's relationship should look like with the new anti-war,
anti-Epstein right.

Here's a preview of some of the topics they cover:

  * What right-wing influencers' criticism of Israel is actually about (**" Are they pro-Palestine or are they just anti-Israel?"** Mehdi asks)

  * If lefties should be criticized for going on right-wing shows, like [Bernie Sanders](https://www.bbc.com/news/world-us-canada-51241462) was when he went on Joe Rogan back in 2020 (**" That was a real low point in… cancel culture," **Naomi says)

  * The vacuum that centrist politicians have created for these pundits (**" Why can't Democrats say what Marjorie Taylor Greene is saying?"** Mehdi asks)

  * What it would take to build a successful left-right coalition (**" Mamdani is showing what the playbook could look like," **Naomi says)
